# DekoVägi slide layouts

> Numbered PowerPoint slide layouts for DekoVägi event-decor presentations, with the rules for choosing them and a kit for building decks.

- [Instructions for AI assistants: rules, catalogue and every field of every layout](https://icyfrosty.github.io/dekovagi-slide-layouts/deck-rules.md)
- [AI kit: the template as .pptx, a helper script and the instructions](https://icyfrosty.github.io/dekovagi-slide-layouts/DekoVagi-AI-kit.zip)
- [Every layout as data](https://icyfrosty.github.io/dekovagi-slide-layouts/layouts.json)
- [Style guide](https://icyfrosty.github.io/dekovagi-slide-layouts/STYLE-GUIDE.md)
